name: amplifier-capability-arxivchecker
description: A reusable study-to-arXiv workflow with evidence checks, LaTeX templates, local preflight, an Amplifier behavior, and a static explanatory site.
runtime: Python >=3.11 for helpers; browser for static site; optional TeX Live and Poppler for paper builds
publication: Public GitHub source and skill. Separate website deployment and arXiv submission are not performed automatically.
